messages:
claire_marketing: Hey team — ready for a fast copy pass on the launch blog. Link: https://docs.example.com/rl-launch-v3. Need signoff on the benchmark sentence, regional CTAs, and the inbound routing snippet. Hoping to lock by tomorrow AM. :sparkles:

ryan_growth: I can do CTA variants + A/B plan. Proposal: region + intent split. Webinar-first vs Quickstart-first. Also propose small GA event names: rl_launch.variant and rl_launch.cta.

marco_eng: Bench source = internal bench-v3 on identical A100 hardware. Suggest we show methodology block. Current line reads "30% faster p99" 11I'd prefer "~30% lower p99 latency (internal tests)" to be safe.

june_legal: Agreed on safer phrasing. We need the methodology inline: e.g., "Based on internal benchmark v3 comparing Redwood runtime to OpenModelX on identical hardware (3,000 requests; mixed seq lengths; p99 across 5 runs)." Also change any "guarantee" or absolute phrasing.

tess_ops: For routing: please include this mapping in the ops playbook: `{"NA":"sales-na","EU":"sales-eu","APAC":"partners-apac"}`. Webinar capacity: EU slots Tue/Thu 9am CET, 40 seats -> auto-waitlist at 40.

claire_marketing: Thanks. Ryan, can you drop short JP/DE CTA variants (<=45 chars)? Ryan: also add UTM param suggestion `?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=rl_launch&utm_variant=A`.

ryan_growth: Short copies: JP webinar: "" (will paste final into doc), DE webinar: "Live-Demo: Jetzt anmelden". A/B variants: A=Webinar-first, B=Quickstart-first.

marco_eng: Pushed the tiny methodology snippet into the draft. Kept it concise:
```Methodology: 3,000 representative requests; mixed seq lengths (64/256/1024); p99 latency averaged over 5 runs; baseline = OpenModelX on identical hardware.```

june_legal: LGTM with two edits: remove the word "representative" (too vague) and change "averaged" to "measured". Then legal is OK.

claire_marketing: Made those tweaks and updated CTAs + UTM. Draft link: https://docs.example.com/rl-launch-v4. If no objections by 10am tomorrow I'll mark copy locked and hand to ops for scheduling. Thanks! :rocket:
